episodes.name: New World Order
episodes.overviewEn: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes realize that their futures are anything but normal.

episodes.name: The Star-Spangled Man
episodes.overviewEn: John Walker is named Captain America, and Sam and Bucky team up against a rebel group.

episodes.name: Power Broker
episodes.overviewEn: Sam and Bucky go to a criminal safe haven to find information about the Super Soldier serum.

episodes.name: The Whole World Is Watching
episodes.overviewEn: John Walker loses patience with Sam and Bucky as they learn more about Karli Morgenthau.

episodes.name: Truth
episodes.overviewEn: John Walker faces consequences for his actions, and Sam and Bucky return to the U.S.

episodes.name: One World, One People
episodes.overviewEn: As The Flag Smashers escalate their efforts, Sam and Bucky take action.
